# Recreation Prompt

Create a single-file browser-native portrait mobile game titled "Elm Street: Stay Awake." Preserve a 5x5 grid exploration/card-survival loop: player starts centered, taps only orthogonally adjacent tiles or current tile, each legal move marks a room visited and opens a random card, HP/SAN resources change by fixed card effects, a good card reveals the exit, and landing on the revealed exit wins. Rebuild the presentation as dream-horror: animated boiler-red dream walls, claw scratches, an awake teen focal marker, alarm-clock goal, compact HUD labels "Body Heat" and "Awake," and darkly comic nightmare cards. Use inline CSS/JS/canvas, mobile-first layout, readable portrait UI, and failure-tolerant catalog-backed fonts/audio/GIF accents.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Current implemented game identity
- genre: mobile-first horror exploration/card-survival game on a 5x5 grid.
- objective: move room-to-room, reveal the exit vector through a good card, then reach the revealed exit/alarm tile.
- input model: tap/click canvas tiles; only orthogonal adjacent tiles or current tile are accepted during PLAY.
- core loop: start game, generate grid, tap a legal tile, mark it visited, draw a random event card, resolve HP/SAN/reveal effects, continue until win or fail.
- fail/friction state: HP reaches 0 after physical hazard cards or SAN reaches 0 after focus/sleep hazard cards; modal restart returns to a fresh board.

## Protected mechanics
- 5x5 default grid generated at start with player centered and exit not at start.
- Canvas pointerdown is the sole playfield input; UI buttons use native click/tap.
- Movement allows orthogonal adjacent tiles and self-wait only; no diagonal or ranged movement.
- Every legal move marks the tile visited and triggers a card unless it lands on an already revealed exit.
- Card odds stay equivalent: 40% neutral, 30% bad, 30% good.
- Good effects preserve semantics: +20 SAN capped at 100, 3x3 reveal, exit reveal inventory flag.
- Bad effects preserve semantics: HP -25, SAN -25, SAN -10, with death checks after resolution.
- Win requires exitRevealed plus landing on exit tile; failure shows an end overlay and restart.

## Remixed target
Elm Street: Stay Awake reframes the grid as a microsleep nightmare maze. The survivor taps adjacent dream-rooms, survives surreal dream cards, finds an alarm-clock echo, and wakes before the clawed dream stalker drains body heat or wakefulness. Presentation, copy, procedural background, HUD language, modal art, and feedback are transformed while the original loop and state semantics remain intact.
